hook.name: BurnRise
hook.description: A meme-token launchpad hook that takes a 1.3% fee on the pair-asset side (split to creator, platform, and contest) and burns 0.5% of the token side on every swap, using beforeSwapReturnsDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta. Only the launchpad can create pools or add liquidity; swaps must fill completely or revert. The hook has no owner and is not upgradeable.
